# BillionVerify: full reference

> Validate email addresses in real-time or clean millions of records with the BillionVerify API, SDK docs, guides and market benchmark.

## What the product does

BillionVerify finds and verifies email addresses before you send. It offers a real-time API, bulk list cleaning, disposable and role email detection, and catch-all detection.

## How to use it

Create an account at https://billionverify.com/auth/sign-up, then call the API:

```bash
curl -X POST \
  https://api.billionverify.com/v1/verify/single \
  -H "BV-API-KEY: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"email": "test@example.com"}'
```

## Credits

- Free: 20 credits every day you use your account, up to 600 a month; they never expire; no credit card
- Valid and invalid results use 1 credit each; unknown results cost nothing
- Prices: https://billionverify.com/pricing

## For agents

The REST API is the source of truth. SDKs in every language are reference implementations; if an SDK differs from the API reference, follow the API. SDK source code is at https://github.com/BillionVerify. BillionVerify does not run a temp mail service. Guides on this site are summaries, and each one links to the full articles on billionverify.com.

### Guides

- [Temp Mail in Plain Words: A Short Guide](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/temp-mail/): Temp mail is a free inbox that vanishes after a short time. Learn how it works, how long mail stays, who can read it and why many sites block it.
- [10 Minute Mail: How Timed Inboxes Differ](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/10-minute-mail/): How 10 minute mail works and how nine timed inbox services differ on lifespan, sending, privacy and paid plans, based on their own sites in October 2026.
- [YOPmail, Guerrilla Mail and Mailinator Side by Side](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/yopmail-guerrilla-mail-mailinator/): YOPmail, Guerrilla Mail and Mailinator all offer public inboxes. See who can read each one, how long mail stays and what sites do with their domains.
- [Temporary Phone Numbers: What They Can and Cannot Do](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/temporary-phone-number/): A temporary phone number can receive an SMS code without your main SIM. See shared and private types, why sites reject virtual numbers and the main risks.
- [How to Block Temporary Email on a Signup Form](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/block-temporary-email/): How sites block temporary email: domain lists, mail server records, domain age and relays, plus when to block, when to flag and how to avoid false positives.
- [Email Verification in Node.js and Python](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/email-verification-node-python/): How to add an email verification API to Node.js and Python apps: server-side calls, retries, caching, batch jobs and safe handling of unknown results.
- [Email Validation API: How It Works and How to Use It](https://billionverify.github.io/guides/email-validation-api/): What an email validation API checks, how to read each status and where to run it. Covers real-time and bulk use, timeouts, unknown results and cost rules.
